listings.name: MCVSC Financial Assistance
listings.summary: Short-term, one-time or temporary payments based on need for Montgomery County veterans and their families, covering necessities of life, transportation and indigent burial, up to a $25,000 lifetime limit.
listings.eligibility: Veterans, active-duty members, and qualifying spouses, widows or widowers, dependent parents drawing VA compensation, and minor or disabled children of veterans, who have lived in Montgomery County for at least three months before applying.
listings.how_to_apply: Gather your documents first (DD-214 or equivalent, photo ID, 60 days of household income and expenses, proof of county residency, marriage certificate, children's birth certificates, landlord or mortgage statement), then call 937-225-4801 for an appointment and complete the Financial Assistance Application from the Commission's page.
listings.location: 627 Edwin C. Moses Blvd., 4th Floor, East Medical Plaza, Dayton, OH 45417
listings.source_title: Financial Assistance - Montgomery County Veterans Service Commission
listings.notes: Read the Commission's Financial Assistance page in full; found while following the mentor ad lead. The page says the aid is not a pension, wage replacement or automatic entitlement, sets the $25,000 lifetime limit by Resolution 17-032202, and lists no income limit or office hours.

listings.name: Veterans Treatment Court Mentor Program
listings.summary: Veteran volunteers serve as peer mentors ('Battle Buddies') to justice-involved veterans going through the Montgomery County Veterans Treatment Court's three-phase program, many dealing with PTSD or traumatic brain injury.
listings.eligibility: Veterans willing to volunteer as mentors. Mentors join a mentor group that meets twice a month with the Mentor Coordinator and guest speakers; mentees are assigned by compatibility and availability.
listings.how_to_apply: Call the Montgomery County Veterans Service Commission at 937-225-4801 and ask for the Mentor Coordinator.
listings.location: 627 Edwin C. Moses Blvd., 4th Floor, East Medical Plaza, Dayton, OH 45417
listings.source_title: Mentors - Montgomery County Veterans Service Commission
listings.notes: Read the Commission's Mentors page in full. Same 'Become a Veteran Mentor' ad also ran as Meta Ad Library 26948903041436089. The page states no background check, training hours or time commitment beyond the twice-monthly mentor meetings. The Veterans Treatment Court began in 2012 and serves honorably discharged veterans.

listings.name: Financial Assistance for Veterans
listings.organization: Veterans Service Commission of Summit County
listings.summary: Short-term, immediate help with basic living expenses such as rent, mortgage, utilities and food for Summit County veterans and their families facing an unexpected emergency. It is free and does not have to be paid back.
listings.eligibility: Veterans who served on active duty for other than training purposes with an honorable or general (under honorable conditions) discharge, and their dependents or widows, who have been bona fide Summit County residents for at least three months before applying and lack enough income because of an emergency or through no fault of their own.
listings.how_to_apply: Walk in, first come first served, no appointment needed, Monday to Friday from 8 a.m. (cutoff listed as 1:45 p.m. in one place and 2 p.m. in another). Bring your DD-214, driver's license or state ID, marriage license and children's birth certificates, plus 30 days of household income and expenses; a face-to-face interview with a Service Officer is required (home visits for those who medically cannot come in).
listings.location: 1060 E. Waterloo Road, Akron, OH 44306
listings.source_title: Financial Assistance for Veterans - Veterans Service Commission of Summit County
listings.notes: Read the Commission's Financial Assistance for Veterans page in full. The site gives two different application cutoffs (1:45 p.m. and 2 p.m.); call to confirm. Eligibility is never decided by phone. A separate dependents page exists on the same site.

listings.name: Transportation Services to VA medical facilities
listings.organization: Veterans Service Commission of Summit County
listings.summary: Rides for Summit County veterans to and from VA medical facilities and the Sandusky Ohio Veterans Home, Monday to Friday, including a bus to the Louis Stokes Cleveland VA Medical Center and Tuesday and Thursday service for northeast Summit County (Twinsburg, Macedonia, Reminderville).
listings.eligibility: Veterans with a valid VA medical appointment who are medically stable; a caregiver may ride if needed. Power wheelchairs cannot be carried, and no ambulatory services are provided.
listings.how_to_apply: Reserve ahead by calling 330-643-2830, using the Commission's online transportation request form, or stopping in; space is limited. For the Louis Stokes bus, book a morning appointment and be at the pickup by 6:15 a.m. (VSC office), 6:30 a.m. (Akron VA Clinic) or 6:45 a.m. (Metro Transit Center); the bus leaves Louis Stokes at 12:30 p.m.
listings.deadline: Book in advance; Monday to Friday service
listings.location: Pickups at 1060 E. Waterloo Road, Akron; the Akron VA Clinic; or the Metro Transit Center
listings.cost: No fare stated on the page
listings.source_title: Transportation Services - Veterans Service Commission of Summit County
listings.notes: Read the Commission's Transportation Services page and FAQ in full. Service may change on federal holidays, in severe weather or heavy traffic. The page does not state a fare.
